title: Oliver Brocato's no-ad-spend organic playbook: TikTok creator studios, meme pages, micro-influencers
summary: Oliver Brocato explains the three organic pillars (content creators, meme pages, influencers) behind his $10M revenue with zero paid ads. The core engine is a high-volume TikTok content studio of many creators on rev-share, using a controversy post plus reply-to-comment sales videos, then repurposing via affiliates.

principles.text: Organic growth rests on three pillars: content creators, meme pages, and micro-influencers.
principles.quote: there are three pillars first is content creators second are memes and third are influencers

principles.text: Success on TikTok is quantity times quality; don't judge organic before making hundreds of videos.
principles.quote: quantity times quality equals success a lot of people focus on the quality part and they ignore the quantity part if you've made less than 500 videos quit the crying

principles.text: Hire many creators to run brand accounts instead of making content yourself or micromanaging scripts; cut low performers, double down on winners.
principles.quote: higher quality Talent cut the low performers and double down on the people that are pushing views

principles.text: Align creators with a small base retainer plus a big affiliate share (about 20%) so their pay tracks performance.
principles.quote: a super small base retainer ultimately I offer them a huge affiliate percentage twenty percent of all sales that they generate by doing so it aligns our interests

principles.text: Use a one-two punch: a controversial top-of-funnel video for eyeballs, then reply-to-comment videos where you sell hard on features and objections.
principles.quote: punch number two is Boom the hook that comes from the right side that right there are the replying to combat videos you make videos responding to comments on the original viral video

principles.text: Rent meme-page distribution for 24-hour link-in-bio posts at $100-$500 instead of paying for ads; and use micro-influencers at scale without scripting.
principles.quote: you're able to pay the owners a hundred bucks 300 bucks 500 bucks for 20 four hour post
